entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: An information element that may be included to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that receives and stores the CAG information list.

entities.name: Assign new CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where the CAG information list IE is included to assign a new list to the UE.

entities.name: Delete CAG information list
entities.description: Condition where the CAG information list IE is included to delete the stored list at the UE.

relations.description: The CAG information list IE may be included under the condition of assigning a new list to the UE.
The CAG information list IE may be included under the condition of deleting the stored list at the UE.
When the assign condition is met, the UE receives and stores a new CAG information list.
When the delete condition is met, the UE deletes its stored CAG information list.
